How to write a useful website brief

Start with what a visitor needs to accomplish. Name the pages and features required for that task, distinguish essentials from later ideas, and identify who owns the content and ongoing updates. A developer can then clarify the unknowns before estimating the work.

For a booking website, for example, define what customers book, who manages availability, whether payment is required, and what happens when a booking changes. “Add bookings” alone leaves those decisions unanswered.
